checks.detail: PEMS and COVE parsed as strict UTF-8 JSON without duplicate keys or non-JSON constants.
COVE tuple, canonical encoding, and exact decoded PEMS equality were checked.
Every endpoint resolves to a record ID and no relation is self-referential.
project_id resolves exactly once to a project record.
Every relation has exactly id, kind, from, and to.
Every source_observation source_id resolves to a source record.
Every typed provenance reference resolves to a source_observation record.
Every derived proposition has a derived_from relation.
Contradictions use canonical endpoint order and unique endpoint pairs.
All relation lifecycle values are absent; no value was inferred.
All relation data values are absent; no value was inferred.
dependency_kind is absent for depends_on relations; no value was inferred.
